content.text: The first iteration succeeds. The second fails because the argument list grows to include another counting qubit. Each controlled Grover gate needs one counting qubit and the same six target qubits; only the control should change between iterations.

input.arguments: {"command":"\"$PY\" -c \"from pathlib import Path; p = Path('buggy.py'); s = p.read_text(); s = s.replace('# BUG: qp changes length on every iteration, but Q\\'s qubit count is fixed', '# Use one counting qubit as control and the same six target qubits.').replace('qp = list(np.arange(n - j, n + lg + 2))', 'qp = [n - j] + list(np.arange(n, n + lg + 2))'); p.write_text(s)\"; \"$PY\" buggy.py"}
